elements.label: Plush mascot character (Oscar-style puppet)
Chessboard and blurred chess pieces background

pattern.description: Live-action puppet shot: a fast camera push-in (about 1.2x) punches in on the mascot as he raises an arm and speaks, background chess pieces blurring further with shallower depth of field.
pattern.why_premium: A short, snappy punch-in timed to the punchline ('too well') adds comedic emphasis and energy without a cut, keeping continuity on the character's performance.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.fromTo('.scene', {scale: 1, yPercent: 0}, {scale: 1.2, yPercent: -2.5, duration: 0.17, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); background layer: fromTo filter blur(4px)->blur(8px) same timing; arm gesture as a separate rotate tween (power2.out, 0.3s) starting slightly before the zoom.
build_hint.remotion: const s = interpolate(frame, [0, 5], [1, 1.2], {easing: Easing.inOut(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight: 'clamp'}); apply transform: scale(s) translateY(-2.5%) on the scene container; arm via interpolate rotate with Easing.out(Easing.quad) over ~9 frames.

notes: Live-action/puppet footage, not UI; camera verdict push_in (scale 1.198). Energy curve has a near-zero frame mid-burst (duplicate frame), possibly a speed-ramped zoom. b02 OCR text 'ho' is a misread of the arm. No SFX candidates.
